prompt: Add a simple help dialog opened by a button.
expected: Choose declarative kirby-modal with ng-template and a meaningful kirby-page-title.
Import ModalComponent, PageTitleComponent and ButtonComponent from secondary entry points.
Use a unique trigger ID and verify focus restoration.

prompt: The state-controlled modal opens once but will not reopen after Escape.
expected: Reset the bound isOpen state on didDismiss.
Verify open, Escape dismissal and reopening.

prompt: Build a wizard that users can deep-link into and protect unsaved changes.
expected: Choose route-based modals with the modal secondary outlet.
Clarify the dismissal policy before configuring canDismiss.
Verify direct navigation, browser back, dismissal and title focus.

prompt: Let users choose several delivery channels.
expected: Choose independent checkboxes, not a single-select dropdown or radio group.
Provide accessible labels and follow the application's forms convention.

prompt: Add a compact frequency selector to a reactive form.
expected: Choose a dropdown rather than an action menu.
Verify whether the selected value is an item object.
Include ReactiveFormsModule and the relevant standalone Kirby imports.

prompt: Add Danish amounts with two decimals and a native date picker.
expected: Verify locale setup and use decimal-mask precision without maxlength.
Explain the native date picker's experimental status and confirm adoption.
Use yyyy-MM-dd for native date values and clarify timezone conversion requirements.

prompt: Use an action sheet to offer Edit and Export in new UI.
expected: Explain the action-sheet deprecation and recommend a menu.
Give its trigger an accessible name and wire real actions.

prompt: Display a payment failure only as a success toast so it is unobtrusive.
expected: Surface the conflict rather than describing failure as success.
Use persistent actionable feedback for essential failure information.
Do not invent an unsupported toast messageType.

prompt: Switch between Overview and History sections without leaving the page.
expected: Choose page tab navigation rather than top-level routed tabs or a segmented filter.
Connect tab IDs and panel ARIA relationships and expose only the active panel.

prompt: A page using kirby-router-outlet keeps polling after navigating away.
expected: Recognize stacked pages may remain alive.
Use enter/leave to pause and resume page-scoped work, not only ngOnDestroy.

prompt: The app's older Kirby version does not contain the semantic tokens in the recipe.
expected: Report the version mismatch and ask for the supported styling or upgrade policy.
Preserve existing legacy styling rather than silently upgrading or inventing tokens.

prompt: Build a calendar with disabled weekends; the repository is not checked out.
expected: Use the bundled index to locate calendar guidance and examples.
Verify date constraint inputs against the installed version.
Prefer a card around the calendar and check contrast and keyboard behavior.

prompt: Use the chart configuration helper for a custom stock chart.
expected: Confirm adoption of the experimental helper and verify Chart.js compatibility.
Register plugins before creation, destroy the chart on teardown, and supply accessible data.

prompt: Use a new Cookbook input on an older app; dependencies and network are unavailable.
expected: State that compatibility cannot be verified.
Ask for the resolved version or relevant declarations/docs before introducing the API.
Do not silently substitute latest APIs or upgrade dependencies.

prompt: Add a localized amount field while keeping the existing submitted value format.
expected: Reuse the existing form, parser, validator and amount-formatting contract.
Keep localized display separate from the submitted domain value.
Do not hardcode currency, precision or timezone assumptions.

prompt: Choose a simple help dialog. The bundled modal rule covers it, but external documentation is unavailable.
expected: Apply the bundled declarative modal rule without requiring Cookbook access.
Verify required APIs against the installed package.
Do not treat source-link availability as a prerequisite for covered usage decisions.

prompt: Create a compact informational modal with a visible heading.
expected: Set an explicit aria-label matching the visible heading.
Use the component attribute or ModalConfig.htmlAttributes for the selected mechanism.
Verify the rendered dialog's accessible name instead of assuming a child supplies it.

prompt: An external example uses deprecated flat cards, but this skill recommends default or outlined cards.
expected: Follow the skill's card usage rule rather than overriding it with the external example.
Keep installed-API compatibility and application requirements as separate checks.
Report and clarify a genuine behavior mismatch rather than silently changing the rule.

prompt: Implement a Kirby confirmation dialog in an already-configured application.
expected: Focus on the Kirby feature APIs and component imports.
Do not add application bootstrap, global providers or infrastructure configuration.
Use the modal recipe and verify confirmation versus cancellation behavior.

prompt: Use kirby-x-combobox in a feature that only has the core Kirby package installed.
expected: Identify combobox as an optional @kirbydesign/extensions-angular export, not a core component.
Report the missing package prerequisite rather than inventing a core import or installing infrastructure.
Check extension and peer compatibility before introducing the feature.

prompt: Build a searchable single selector using objects whose keys are code and title.
expected: Choose the extension combobox rather than treating the core dropdown as searchable.
Configure itemIdProperty and itemTextProperty and use unique string IDs.
Keep the selected item as the form value/change payload, not an array or DOM event.
Provide an accessible name and preserve the existing forms convention.

prompt: Show a dark skeleton while a summary loads, using the skeleton theme input.
expected: Identify theme as deprecated and ineffective; use the surrounding Kirby surface.
Use supported shapes and CSS sizing.
Tie placeholder visibility to actual loading state and provide surrounding accessible status text.

prompt: Build a sidebar with expanded IDs supplied as an array and plain text inside its header.
expected: Use the public sidebar/menu composition and typed SidebarMenuItem contracts.
Use Set<string> for expandedItems and checkedItems and string IDs for selectedItem.
Place header content in logo or action slots instead of relying on un-slotted text.

prompt: Add an image banner that opens an external resource, can be dismissed and may fail to load its image.
expected: Use externalLink for external navigation rather than assuming bannerClick also handles that branch.
Subscribe to dismissClick to expose dismissal and keep it separate from activation.
Handle imageError explicitly.

prompt: Show a decorative spot illustration in every size using an arbitrary image name.
expected: Use published illustration names and verify the chosen size has an asset.
Recognize a missing size renders no illustration.
Hide decorative illustrations from accessibility exposure and keep meaning in accompanying text.

prompt: Format a number with formatNumber: { digitsInfo: '1.2-2' } and pass a plain number to the amount pipe.
expected: Pass a digitsInfo string to formatNumber, not a configuration object.
Pass an Amount object with amount and currencyCode to the amount pipe.
Use existing locale/extension settings and preserve the raw sign and currency unless requirements explicitly change presentation.

prompt: Use timeOrDate to show time for today when the browser timezone differs from the configured display timezone.
expected: Distinguish browser-local today classification from configured-timezone formatting.
Verify day-boundary behavior rather than assuming both use the configured timezone.
Use explicit date/time display when the conditional output would misrepresent the requirement.

prompt: Format account and phone numbers, then submit their displayed strings back to the API.
expected: Use AccountNumber and PhoneNumber payload shapes and preserve their original values.
Treat registration padding, account zero removal and phone chunking as display behavior.
Validate digit-only phone input independently rather than treating formatting as validation.
